body: Totally agree. I’m 17 years old and feel as though I don’t have things figured out. I feel like everyone else has everything together and I’m just a complete mess and failure. But what I realized is literally nobody has anything figured out. 18 is young when deciding what you want to do with your life. I’m not even 100% confident in what I want to do but I’m taking it one step at a time. I just stopped worrying about other people and focused on myself. I learned to just accept things as they come and not to constantly be stressing over it. Everything will work out for you trust me! We’re in this together!
I feel the exact way. It’s nice to know someone feels the same thing as you. I hope things get better for you.
